_comment: Proposed by route-legacyshareobject (2026-10-15) for migration/parity-exemptions.json; same format, merged by the orchestrator. Capture and timing artifacts only.

rules.reason: The household photo was removed from the capture as person data (img src="", data-masked-src="user-image", live size 65x43), so the replayed reference renders the image column 0 px high (70x0, text column offset 34 px); the clone shows the neutral mock placeholder at 65x43 (Q-W2C-1), as the live capture did. Same artifact as CAPTURE-MASKED-IMAGE-HOUSEHOLDDETAILS. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

Result_Item_Image's loading-item shimmer is a CSS animation of background-position; the captured value is the animation phase at the capture instant (101.3 px loading, 96.0 px offline) and differs on every run. Same artifact as CAPTURE-SKELETON-SHIMMER-PHASE. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

ignoreSubtrees.reason: The loading capture held the TST requests until the OutSystems request timeout, so ProfileList's DataActionGetAvailableUsers had failed (HasFetchError: ListBlankSlate exclamation-triangle "Error Searching"); the mock loading scenario never answers, so the clone shows the compiled fetching branch (ListBlankSlate spinner fa-spin "Searching", ProfileList.mvc.js view :532-620). Icon and message masked in DOM and pixel comparison for the loading state only; the same error markup passes in the offline state. Same artifact as CAPTURE-LOADING-FETCH-TIMEOUT. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
ignoreSubtrees.evidence: migration/screens/LegacyShareObject/analysis/dom/loading.html:132-145; migration/screens/LegacyShareObject/parity/loading.json (class, text, style, pseudo, layout, position, pixel hotspots 120-200,280-320); parity/offline.json passes

ignoreSubtrees.reason: In the loading capture the household UBT_LazyImage had already received the failed GetSignedImagesInBulk answer after the request timeout (outer SkeletonSection off, cyan no-image fallback with connect-icon-home); the mock loading scenario never answers, so the shared UBT_LazyImage keeps its skeleton (ubt-skeleton-section, grey elements, hidden icon). The fallback markup passes in the offline state. Same artifact as CAPTURE-LOADING-FETCH-TIMEOUT-HOUSEHOLDDETAILS-IMAGE. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

callOrderFree.reason: ScreenBlock_ShareObject's OnReady GetHouseholdDetails starts while the app-start chain runs: on TST it started before AfterInitialize, the clone's shell calls AfterInitialize right after SynchAppContext, before the lazily loaded screen mounts. Its place among the app-start calls depends on timing; counts and inputs are still compared. Same artifact as CALL-ORDER-APPSTART-USERINFO. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
